Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class RegionManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.RegionManager
public class RegionManager extends Object
Manages regions created or defined during action execution. Handles both anonymous and named regions.

This class encapsulates region management functionality that was previously embedded in ActionResult.

Since:
2.0
